hero.title_line1: This is not just a game.
hero.subtitle: Dive into a space where play is a way to know yourself, understand systems, and co-create reality with others.

features.title: What are these games
features.desc: Not entertainment — a tool. Every game is a structured situation where you think, decide and reflect.
features.card1_desc: You don't observe — you play a role, make decisions and feel the consequences in real time.
features.card2_desc: Conflicting interests, coalitions, negotiations — everything that exists in real teams, but in a safe space.
features.card3_desc: The debrief is the most important part. What happened? Why did you decide that way? What does it say about you?

audience.title: Who are these games for
audience.desc: For those who want more — from themselves, their team, and reality.
audience.card1_desc: Want to know yourself better, test your limits and expand your perception of reality — these games are made for you.
audience.card2_desc: Team-building games or forecasting sessions — when you need to see the future through the lens of play.
audience.card3_desc: A space where ideas are born. Where play becomes a method of thinking, not just entertainment.

how.title: How it works
how.desc: Four steps from invitation to insight.
how.step1_desc: The moderator selects a template or builds a custom scenario for your group.
how.step2_desc: A character with interests, resources, and decisions to make awaits you.
how.step3_desc: Negotiations, votes, unexpected alliances and conflicts.
how.step4_desc: Reflection after the game often changes how you see real life.
